ValidationRule.description: DEACTIVATED for PCR v2: pricing is provided by Sales/Finance during R1 and enforced by the per-sector done-check, so requiring it before Sandbox Approval contradicts the v2 flow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Draft")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Cancelled")), OR( ISBLANK(Price_Americas__c), AND( NOT(Same_Pricing_All_Regions__c), ISBLANK(Price_EMEA__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Price (Americas) and Price (EMEA) (if not "Same Pricing All Regions") must be filled before submitting for approval.
